hero.subtitle: Pomo mar faili mar peer-to-peer mar tieng' manyien
hero.description: Kuom teknolojia manyien ma onge pinywa. Onge ma server mar pinywa. Onge gimoro achiel ma rwenyo gik.

about.title: Kuom
about.intro: {project} en plaftaform mar tieng' manyien mar pomo mar faili mar peer-to-peer mogerie kuom teknolojia manyien ma onge pinywa. Oriwo interface mayot mar jatich gi gima ger ma onge pinywa duto, kendo ochiwo pomo mar data mar ritruok kendo mar geno ma ok jiwore kuom loch moro amora mar pinywa. Projekti ni en open source, igolore e bwo {license}.

decentralized.title: Netwak ma onge pinywa duto
decentralized.description: Onge ma server mar pinywa, onge gimoro achiel ma rwenyo gik. Jotich manyo kendo yiko gik kuomgi giwegi, ma ok jiwore kuom indexer, tracker kata database moro amora mar pinywa.

accessControl.title: Telo mar donjo matin matin
accessControl.description: Ng'ato ang'ata nyalo chako netwak mare gi chike mage owuon nono. E netwak ka netwak, lero migepe mag jotich: wuon, admin, jagoyo nono, moderator kod jayiko. Tel matin matin kuom ng'ama nyalo goyo, moderate kendo yiko gik.

ui.title: Interface mar jatich mar duong'
ui.description: Interface mar media center maler kendo mariek, moger ne desktop, TV kod plaftaform mag simu. Wuoth mayot gi keyboard, mouse, gamepad kata kontrolu mar bor. Jotich mariek nyalo tiyo gi software kaka file server ma onge wang' kuom command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Kit data ma dhano nyalo somo
dataFormat.description: Kit data mar LISH ogerie kuom JSON, gi mor ma yot loso, somo kendo winjo. Pog gigi gi metadata maler kendo manyikalore, ng'ato ang'ata nyalo nono mayot.

security.title: Limbe kod ritruok
security.description: Wuoyo duto mar peer-to-peer oketie e enkripshon, kendo mondo data mari osik kuom limbe sa ma odhi. Jotich nyalo pondo e bwo VPN mondo gimed lath mar lim. {project} luoro limbe magi kuom kaka ogeri.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software ni iyud kuom Windows, Linux kod macOS. Tiye kuom gima ihero ang'ata.

download.title: Yik piny
download.description: Yud {project} mar plaftaform mari. Yik piny duto en mar nono kendo open source.

macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper yieyo ma-app maok osigne/notarized ma oyik piny kuom internet, gi kosa mar {error}.
